what: Frozen question list for the search page's section search (words, and words plus meaning). Written BEFORE any retrieval was run on it; committed before it was run (the commit time is the freeze).
written_by: Claude (2026-10-23), from its own knowledge of the Indian statutes: NOT lawyer-made, not independently checked. A wrong expected section would count as a miss against the search, so read the misses before trusting them.
rule: Hit at 5 / at 10: at least one of the expected (Act code, section) is among the first 5 / 10 PROVISIONS of the result. Shelf Acts are on (ACT_SHELF=on). Only the section search is measured: not cases, not passages.
